name: Tidio
tagline: AI-powered customer service software combining live chat, chatbot automation, and the Lyro AI agent for e-commerce and SMBs.
description: Tidio is a customer service platform founded in 2013 that combines live chat, AI chatbots, and the Lyro AI agent to help small and mid-size businesses handle support at scale. The Lyro AI resolves up to 67% of customer queries automatically in under 6 seconds using the company's own knowledge base. Tidio integrates natively with Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress, HubSpot, and 30+ other tools, centralising website chat, email, Instagram, and WhatsApp into a single inbox.

Live chat for e-commerce websites
Order status and product Q&A automation
Lead generation through chat flows
Omnichannel inbox management
Support ticket handling and triage
Proactive chat triggers for visitor engagement

Live chat widget with real-time typing preview
Multichannel inbox: website, email, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger
Visual chatbot flow builder (Flows)
Shopify-native integration with order lookup and product recommendations
Operating hours and auto-assignment rules
Advanced analytics and conversation reporting
Macros and canned responses for agent efficiency
Custom branding and widget customization
OpenAPI access on higher plans

Lyro AI agent resolves a high percentage of queries without human intervention
Deep Shopify native integration ideal for e-commerce stores

faqs.question: What is Lyro AI and how does it differ from a regular chatbot?
faqs.answer: Lyro is Tidio's conversational AI agent powered by Claude. Unlike rule-based chatbots that follow fixed decision trees, Lyro understands natural language and generates contextual answers from your knowledge base, resolving up to 67% of queries automatically without pre-written scripts.

faqs.question: Does Tidio have a free plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tidio's free plan includes 50 billable conversations per month, 10 seats, live chat, ticketing, and basic analytics with no time limit.

faqs.question: Which e-commerce platforms does Tidio support?
faqs.answer: Tidio has native integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and Adobe Commerce (Magento), with deeper AI features on Shopify including order-status lookups and product recommendations.

faqs.question: Can Tidio handle multiple messaging channels in one inbox?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tidio centralises conversations from your website chat, email, Instagram Direct, Facebook Messenger, and WhatsApp into a single shared inbox.

faqs.question: Is Tidio GDPR compliant?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tidio is GDPR compliant and provides data processing agreements for EU customers.

name: Botpress
tagline: Enterprise-grade open-source AI agent platform for building, deploying, and managing customer support chatbots across all channels.
description: Botpress is an enterprise AI agent platform founded in 2017 by Sylvain Perron in Quebec, Canada. The platform has deployed over 750,000 AI agents across web, WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, and Messenger, powering customer support for companies of all sizes. Botpress offers a visual drag-and-drop studio, a built-in LLM inference engine, human handoff, and knowledge-base RAG - all without per-seat or per-AI-usage fees on paid plans. It is open-source at its core and supports self-hosted or cloud deployment.
use_cases: Automated customer support on website and messaging apps
WhatsApp Business chatbot deployment
Internal IT helpdesk automation
Lead qualification and sales chatbot
Knowledge-base FAQ bot with RAG
Human handoff for escalated support tickets
Multi-channel bot from a single configuration
key_features: Visual drag-and-drop bot studio (Botpress Studio)
LLMz custom inference engine with LLM-agnostic architecture
Knowledge Base with RAG for document and URL ingestion
Multi-channel deployment: web, WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, Messenger, Telegram
Human handoff with full conversation context to live agents
AI Transition intent classification without manual training phrases
Built-in Botpress Desk AI helpdesk module
Role-based access control (RBAC) on Team plan
Self-hosted or managed cloud deployment options
Unlimited bots on all paid plans (as of May 2026)

faqs.question: Is Botpress open source?
faqs.answer: Yes. Botpress has an open-source core that you can self-host. The commercial cloud plans (Plus, Team, Enterprise) add managed hosting, priority support, and enterprise features on top of the open-source foundation.

faqs.question: How many conversations does the free plan include?
faqs.answer: The free plan includes 100 conversations per month, 3 AI agents, and 1 seat. It is a hard cap with no paid add-ons available on the free tier.

faqs.question: Which messaging channels can I deploy Botpress bots on?
faqs.answer: Botpress supports webchat widget, WhatsApp Business, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and more from a single bot configuration.

faqs.question: Does Botpress charge per seat?
faqs.answer: No. As of May 2026, paid plans (Plus and Team) do not charge per seat or per AI usage, making costs more predictable as your team grows.

faqs.question: Can Botpress hand off to a human agent?
faqs.answer: Yes. Botpress has a built-in human handoff feature that escalates unresolved conversations to live agents with full conversation context preserved.

name: FlutterFlow
tagline: Visual app development platform for building cross-platform mobile, web, and desktop apps with AI assistance and full Flutter code export.
description: FlutterFlow is a visual no-code and low-code app builder founded in 2020 by former Google engineers Alex Greaves and Abel Mengistu. It enables developers, designers, and non-technical founders to build production-ready Flutter apps for iOS, Android, and web using a drag-and-drop canvas with 200+ pre-built UI components. FlutterFlow natively integrates with Firebase, Supabase, REST APIs, and Stripe, and exports clean, ownable Flutter source code with no vendor lock-in. The platform has over 3.3 million users and is backed by Y Combinator and Google Ventures.
use_cases: Rapid mobile app prototyping and production deployment
Building iOS and Android apps without writing Flutter code
Launching web apps from a single codebase
Team collaboration on app design and logic
Exporting Flutter source code for developer handoff
Integrating Firebase or Supabase backends visually
Creating enterprise internal tools quickly
key_features: Drag-and-drop WYSIWYG canvas with 200+ pre-built UI components
Action Flow Editor for visual logic and business rules
Native Firebase integration (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Functions, Analytics)
Native Supabase integration with real-time PostgreSQL sync
REST API, GraphQL, and Swagger/OpenAPI import support
GitHub integration and branch-based collaboration on Growth and above
One-click deployment to App Store, Play Store, and web
Full Flutter source code export with no vendor lock-in
Figma frame import for design-to-app workflows
AI-assisted design features for faster layout generation

Active community and extensive template library accelerate development

faqs.question: Do I need to know how to code to use FlutterFlow?
faqs.answer: No. FlutterFlow is designed for both developers and non-technical users. You can build full apps using the visual drag-and-drop editor without writing code. Developers can also add custom Dart code or custom actions when needed.

faqs.question: Can I export the Flutter source code?
faqs.answer: Yes, on the Basic plan ($39/month) and above. You get clean, readable Flutter code that you own completely - there is no lock-in and you can continue building outside FlutterFlow.

faqs.question: Which backends does FlutterFlow support natively?
faqs.answer: FlutterFlow natively integrates with Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Functions) and Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage). It also supports REST APIs, GraphQL, and Swagger/OpenAPI imports for any custom backend.

faqs.question: Can FlutterFlow apps be published to both iOS App Store and Google Play?
faqs.answer: Yes. FlutterFlow supports one-click deployment to the iOS App Store, Google Play Store, and web from a single codebase on the Basic plan and above.

faqs.question: Does FlutterFlow support team collaboration?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Growth plan ($80/month) supports 2 users with GitHub integration and branch-based workflows. The Business plan ($150/month) expands this to 5 users with 5 open branches per project.

name: Lindy
tagline: No-code AI agent builder that creates autonomous AI employees to manage email, meetings, scheduling, CRM updates, and workflows across 4,000+ apps.
description: Lindy is a no-code AI automation platform founded in 2023 by Flo Crivello, a former Uber product manager, and headquartered in San Francisco. The platform lets users build AI agents - called Lindies - by describing tasks in plain English, without writing any code. Each agent handles inbox triage, meeting notes, calendar coordination, CRM updates, and custom workflows by connecting to over 4,000 apps including Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Zoom. Trusted by over 400,000 professionals, Lindy has raised $50M in funding from Menlo Ventures, Coatue, and Battery Ventures.
use_cases: Inbox triage and AI email drafting in user's voice
Automated meeting notes and follow-up generation
Calendar coordination and scheduling management
CRM updates from meeting and call context
Lead research and prospect outreach
Customer support routing and response drafting
Multi-agent chained workflows for complex business processes
iMessage/SMS-based task delegation on mobile
key_features: Natural language agent creation - describe tasks in plain English
Inbox management with AI triage, prioritization, and reply drafting
Automated meeting lifecycle support - prep, attendance, notes, follow-ups
Calendar coordination with focus-time protection and rescheduling
Multi-agent workflows with handoffs between specialized Lindies
Human approval checkpoints insertable in any workflow
CRM auto-update from conversation and meeting context
iMessage/SMS mobile delegation interface

4,000+ app integrations via native connectors

7-day free trial on all plans with no credit card required
cons: No permanent free plan - all usage requires a paid subscription after 7-day trial
Pricing is month-to-month only with no annual billing option to reduce cost
Usage limits (inboxes and throughput) are tied to plan tier, not individual agent count

faqs.question: What is a 'Lindy' and how do I create one?
faqs.answer: A Lindy is an AI agent you create by describing what you want it to do in plain English. You specify triggers (e.g., 'when I receive an email from a prospect'), actions (e.g., 'draft a reply in my tone'), and connected apps - no coding required.

faqs.question: Does Lindy have a free plan?
faqs.answer: No. Lindy is a paid product starting at $49.99/month. Every plan includes a 7-day free trial with full access to Plus features and no credit card required.

faqs.question: Can multiple Lindies work together on a single task?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lindy supports multi-agent workflows where specialized agents hand off tasks to each other. For example, a lead research Lindy can pass enriched data to an outreach Lindy automatically.

faqs.question: Is Lindy HIPAA compliant?
faqs.answer: HIPAA compliance with a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is available on the Enterprise plan. Standard plans (Plus, Pro, Max) are not HIPAA certified.

faqs.question: Which AI model does Lindy use?
faqs.answer: Lindy uses multiple underlying LLMs to power its agents. The specific model is not publicly disclosed, as Lindy abstracts model selection to optimize for each task type.

faqs.question: Can Lindy manage my calendar and meetings automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lindy can coordinate scheduling, send calendar invites, protect focus time, prepare meeting briefs, take meeting notes, and send follow-ups - all autonomously once configured.

name: MagicSchool
tagline: AI platform for K-12 educators with 80+ tools for lesson planning, assessment creation, IEP drafting, and student feedback - FERPA and COPPA compliant.
description: MagicSchool is an AI platform for K-12 educators founded in 2023 by Adeel Khan, a former teacher and assistant principal, in Denver, Colorado. The platform offers over 80 AI-powered tools designed specifically for teachers, covering lesson planning, standards-aligned assessments, IEP generation, differentiated instruction, rubric creation, and student communication drafts. MagicSchool is trusted by over 5.5 million educators and has raised $65.3 million in funding. It is FERPA, COPPA, SOC 2, and GDPR compliant, and student data is never sold or used to train AI models.

faqs.question: Is MagicSchool free for teachers?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Free plan gives individual teachers unlimited access to all 80+ AI teacher tools and 50+ student tools with no time limit. The Plus plan at $12.99/month (or $99.96/year) adds unlimited generations, Studio Mode editing, and early access to new features.

faqs.question: Is MagicSchool safe to use with student data?
faqs.answer: Yes. MagicSchool is FERPA, COPPA, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type 2 certified. Student data is never sold, shared with third parties for advertising, or used to train AI models. The platform holds a 93% privacy rating from Common Sense Education.

faqs.question: Which LMS platforms does MagicSchool integrate with?
faqs.answer: MagicSchool integrates with Google Classroom, Canvas, Schoology, and Clever for SSO and roster sync. Teachers can export content directly to Google Docs and Microsoft Word with one click.

faqs.question: Can students use MagicSchool directly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Teachers can create moderated Student Rooms where students interact with AI tools in a safe, teacher-controlled environment. The platform includes smart alerts that prevent PII leaks and flag biased or factually incorrect AI outputs.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Free and Plus plans?
faqs.answer: The Free plan has daily generation limits on some tools. The Plus plan ($12.99/month or $99.96/year) removes all generation limits, adds unlimited output history, Studio Mode for editing outputs, early access to MagicSchool Labs, and self-paced professional development content.

faqs.question: Does MagicSchool offer district-wide licensing?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Enterprise plan provides institution-wide staff access, full SIS/LMS integration via Clever and ClassLink, custom tool creation, district branding, advanced data dashboards, and white-glove onboarding with a dedicated customer success manager.
